client.name: Phoenix Roofing — AI Services Blast
client.description: All Phoenix-metro roofing companies — AI automation services pitch (voice agent, lead prospecting, chatbot). Storm season, high-ticket jobs.

icp.q_keywords: roofing OR roofer OR roof repair OR roof replacement OR shingles OR storm damage

qualification.ideal_customer_description: A Phoenix-area roofing company with 5-200 employees. High-ticket jobs ($5K-25K+). Owner or sales team is on roofs doing estimates and misses calls. Companies that rely on storm season leads. Still using manual processes for estimates and scheduling.
qualification.service_focus: AI voice agent that answers every call 24/7 including storm damage inquiries, AI lead prospecting to fill pipeline before storm season, and AI chatbot to capture website visitors looking for estimates

custom_guidelines: Do NOT use phrases like 'I hope this email finds you well'
Lead with the high-ticket missed opportunity angle - one missed roofing call = $10K-25K lost
Mention storm season is coming and they need to capture every lead
Reference specific pain: missing calls while on roofs doing estimates, slow follow-up on storm damage leads, losing bids because they respond too slowly
email.template_subject: {name} — every missed call during storm season
